name: @pipedog/transport-whatsapp
description: WhatsApp Business calling for pipedog: a port of Pipecat's WhatsAppClient and WhatsAppApi (Meta Cloud API calling webhooks, HMAC signature checks, SDP accept/reject/terminate) on the SmallWebRTC transport.

needs.all: A WhatsApp Business account with Calling enabled, an access token and a public HTTPS webhook URL.
needs.bun: A long-lived server that can use UDP (SmallWebRTC runs on werift).
needs.node: A long-lived server that can use UDP (SmallWebRTC runs on werift).
needs.deno: A long-lived server that can use UDP (SmallWebRTC runs on werift).
needs.workerd: Webhook verification, signature checks and API calls only. There is no WebRTC, so calls cannot be answered.
